response.sql: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, order_volume, order_volume / NULLIF(SUM(order_volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volumes), scored AS (SELECT product_id, order_volume, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(order_volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM scored WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Order volume is the sum of product_quantity in Order_Items, treating the VARCHAR quantity as a numeric value. Non-numeric quantities may require data-specific cleanup; the schema does not specify their format.
